nodes.label: Cascade Logo Icon
nodes.description: Icon-only SVG logo for the Cascade product. Composed of three nested/overlapping triangles arranged in a waterfall-cascade pattern. The large central triangle has a mint-green (#6EFDB5) outlined stroke with an off-white (#F0F7F4) fill. Two smaller flanking triangles mirror the same color scheme. A subtle drop shadow filter is applied. The triangular cascade motif visually represents the product name 'Cascade'. Dimensions: 63x36 viewBox.
